title: Da Yun / Liu Nian Timeline Professional Reading
objective: Compose natal whole-chart priorities, the full Da Yun sequence, an explicitly selected Liu Nian window, and the seven professional life topics into one readable time-axis without converting timing into event prediction.
compositionRules: Natal priorities remain the baseline and are never overwritten by Da Yun or Liu Nian.
Each Da Yun cycle is composed with its Ten-God functional groups, natal interactions, priority references and life-topic relevance.
A selected Liu Nian adds a narrower annual layer only when target date, time and timezone are explicit.
Each of the seven life topics preserves its natal reading and records whether Da Yun and Liu Nian enter as primary, supporting or contextual relevance.
Cross-layer relations may increase reading relevance but never create event certainty.
